page: Microsoft Azure NC16as_T4_v3 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine belonging to the NCASv3_T4 family. It is equipped with 16 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor on the x86_64 architecture, managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 110.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 6.88 GB of RAM per virtual core.

Acceleration is delivered by a single NVIDIA T4 GPU with 15 GB of VRAM. For local storage, the server includes a 360 GB SSD. Additionally, the instance is Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external storage volumes. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

This hardware profile positions the server as a cost-efficient option for entry-level GPU workloads, balancing dedicated AMD CPU cores with a low-power NVIDIA T4 accelerator. The resource density is optimized for workloads such as machine learning inference, lightweight deep learning training, video transcoding, and graphics rendering.
